settings.description: How far last season's scoring is pulled back toward the league mean (0 = as-is, 1 = every club average).
Points of home-court advantage: half to the home side, half off the away side.
Spread of one team's score in one game. Assumed by the workbook, not yet checked against results.
Spread of the winning margin. Assumed by the workbook, not yet checked against results.
Points per 40 minutes at replacement level; a missing player's minutes are first refilled at this rate.
Share of a missing player's scoring above replacement that teammates recover.
Largest multiple of a player's output that teammates' absences can produce.
Share of lost minutes taken by the listed rotation (minutes display only).
Weight of a scorer's recent average against the model in his round projection.
1: team and player projections agree (the boost cap binds the players; what they cannot take is credited at replacement level). 0: the workbook's behaviour, which can leave points unassigned.
1: scale each squad so its players' points sum to the club's projected score.
1: scale actual scores to regulation length before updating ratings (a documented deviation; the workbook did not).
